title: Meteorology, Geological Hazards and Climate Change Act 2016 (No. 25 of 2016)
evidence: Cover of the official PDF: "Assent: 26/01/2017 Commencement: 01/02/2017". Opened https://mocca.gov.vu/images/publications/legislation/VMGD/Meteorology%2C%20Geological%20Hazards%20and%20Climate%20Change%20Act%202016.pdf on 2026-11-03. Section 38 of the same text says "This Act commences on the day on which it is published in the Gazette", which the PDF does not date.
notes: Sets up the National Advisory Board on Climate Change and Disaster Risk Reduction (s.7), Director functions for meteorology, geological hazards and climate change (Parts 4 to 6, including mitigation, CDM and REDD+ coordination in s.23), asset protection (Part 8) and offences (s.32). Duties on private persons are limited to the offence of issuing unauthorised hazard or weather warnings, interfering with protected assets and failing to comply with removal notices (ss.28 to 32); there is no emissions or reporting duty. Not stored: row VU-MOCCA-ADOPTED is permission requested (mocca.gov.vu states no reuse terms). Government English text: this PDF, English only; the Act is enacted in English and French, and a French or Bislama text was not found on mocca.gov.vu, parliament.gov.vu (links redirect to PacLII) or environment.gov.vu; PacLII could not be opened from the cloud address.

title: Environmental Protection and Conservation Act [CAP 283] (Act 12 of 2002), Consolidated Edition 2006 with 2011 amendments
evidence: Cover of the official PDF (Laws of the Republic of Vanuatu, Consolidated Edition 2006): "Commencement: 10 March 2003". Opened the PDF on 2026-11-03.
notes: Environmental framework act: Director and Environmental Registry (Part 2), environmental impact assessment (Part 3, s.18), community conservation areas, bioprospecting permits. The brief named 2010 and 2016 amendments; the only official text found is the 2006 edition with the 2011 amendments, and no amending Act of 2010 or 2016 was found on mocca.gov.vu or environment.gov.vu (PacLII, which would list them, could not be opened). No climate or emissions duty. Not stored: row VU-DEPC-CONSOLIDATED is permission requested (environment.gov.vu: "All rights reserved"). Government English only; no French or Bislama text found on those sites.

title: Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations, Order No. 175 of 2011 (unofficial consolidated version 2012)
evidence: Section 32: "This Order commences on the day on which it is made." followed by "Made at Port Vila this 22nd day of August, 2011". Opened the PDF on 2026-11-03.
notes: Implements Part 3 of vu-environmental-protection-conservation-act: activities needing a preliminary assessment or EIA (Schedule 1), EIA report contents, approval, penalty notices. The PDF is headed UNOFFICIAL CONSOLIDATED VERSION 2012. Not stored: row VU-DEPC-CONSOLIDATED is permission requested. Government English only; no French or Bislama text found.
